Greetings! My name is #username. I am working for the Population Council Consulting Pvt. Ltd., New Delhi. We are conducting a survey for the government, commissioned by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to assess the delivery of healthcare services by HWC-SHCs, HWC-PHCs and HWC-UPHCs, and to identify the changes across service provision and care seeking in AB-HWCs in your state. We will make every effort to keep the information provided during the study private and confidential. The form that contains your responses will be stored safely in our office computers. Your participation in this study is completely voluntary. There are no direct benefits to you for participating in the study. You will not receive any compensation for doing so. We thank you for taking time to understand and showing your interest in the study.
